units.source_text: ”他叹一口气，又叮嘱他说：“你把这信送去，

en.t: He sighed and once again urged him, saying, “Take this letter and deliver it,
but you absolutely must not let anyone see it!
If it is seen, it will be disastrous!”

units.source_text: 随从遵命，心中想道：“少辅道定常常探询大将的动静，

en.t: The attendant obeyed, thinking to himself, “So there was a reason why Shosuke Michisada was always asking about the General’s movements,

units.source_text: 又打听宇治方面的情形，原来是有道理的。”

en.t: and also inquiring about affairs at Uji after all.”

units.source_text: 但他不敢在大将面前随便饶舌。

en.t: But he did not dare chatter carelessly in front of the General.

units.source_text: 大将也不欲使仆人们知道详情，所以不再问他。

en.t: The General, too, did not want the servants to know the details, so he questioned him no further.

units.source_text: 宇治方面，看见薰大将的使者来得比往日更加频繁，

en.t: At Uji, seeing that General Kaoru’s messengers were coming even more frequently than before,
they became troubled by all sorts of added worries.

units.source_text: 他的信中只有寥寥数语：

en.t: His letter contained only a few brief words:
